answer: The ledger pays accounts younger than 50 epochs from one 600-token pool per epoch, split evenly, and burns an entry fee of 100 tokens plus 20 per young account already present. Any age claim beyond its own epoch count is fable. Age accrues one epoch at a time and can't be pre-built in parallel. With 100 honest newcomers, a farm on its own island of nodes pays 2,480 for its 20th fake, which earns about 210 over 50 epochs. Every added key helps forge a deeper loss.
